usedFor: Jumpseller holds the online store, and Google Drive copies a file through “Copy a File” when a product arrives.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Added” in Jumpseller, then “Copy a File” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gets its own copy of a master file, which you can name in the action.

watchOut: “Share File With Anyone” makes a file reachable by link, so check its access level before using it.
